description: Provides an English translation of a Chinese ship mod. It includes super dreadnoughts for all core factions plus XIV and LG, along with new fighters, weapons, and hullmods. The pack also features standard ships for all factions, a unique Atlas variant for Pirates, and reskinned existing ship systems.

discordPostHtml:
My poor second translation attempt of a great CN super ship mod.

  • Contains super dreadnoughts for all the core factions + XIV & LG
  • Contains some new fighters, weapons and hullmods
  • Has some normal ships for all factions too, plus 999th variant of Atlas for the Pirates
  • TDS Reskin of existing ship systems

Original Thread: https://www.fossic.org/thread-8273-1-1.html
